set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

what_each_new_part_touches: The black hose is plugged onto the cylinder's nozzle and its other end goes to a nozzle of the left switch block (red circle left). The grey hose is plugged onto the T-piece and the right switch block (red circle right).
where_everything_is_after: the black hose runs from the air cylinder to the left switch; the grey hose runs from a switch to the T-piece; the pump line is closed

why.problem_solved: Connects the pump, switches and cylinder into one air circuit.
why.why_these_parts: Pressing the pump pushes air through the T-piece and the switches into the cylinder.
why.sets_up_for_later: Steps 28 onward continue on the top of the frame.

review_note: No new parts in this step (hoses were added in step 26). Which nozzle each hose end takes is shown only by the two red circles.
